info.description:
HTTP face of `litsense_core` for the LitSense Node backend. Every `/v1` route is one public
function of `docs/API_CONTRACT.md` with the same request fields and response schema.

* **Auth**: send `X-API-Key: <SERVICE_API_KEY>` on every `/v1` call and on `/metrics`.
* **Request id**: send `X-Request-Id` (letters, digits, `._:-`, up to 64) to correlate logs; the
  response echoes it, or a generated one.
* **Rate limit**: per `X-Client-Id` when sent (a per-reader pseudonym, never an email), else per
  client address. 429 carries `Retry-After`.
* **Errors**: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"?}}`. 400 invalid input
  (including an unknown `book_id`), 401, 404, 413, 429, 503 not ready or overloaded, 500.
* **LLM routes** (`explain`, `chat-turn`, `parse-onboarding`) answer with the template path after
  the hard timeout and then send `X-LitSense-Fallback: timeout`.
* **Readiness**: `/ready` is 503 until the bundle is loaded; `/v1` calls get 503 `not_ready`.
info.title: LitSense model service

get.description: `book_insights(book_id)`: aspect bars, review summary, spoiler-safe snippets. Cached.

Every book of the loaded bundle in `book_id` order, for seeding the backend's `books`
table (contract section 7 item 1). Page with `offset` and `limit` until `items` is shorter
than `limit`; reseed when `bundle_version` changes.

post.description:
`chat_turn(state, session, message)`. Persist `reply.session` and send it back next turn
(contract section 4). LLM-backed with the hard timeout (then the rule parser and templates).

`explain(state, book_id)`: LLM text when available and valid, else the template.
LLM-backed with the hard timeout; cached for CACHE_TTL_S per (bundle, state, book).
`home_rails(state)`: top picks, because-you-liked, trending and the conditional rails.

80 ms on the ranker path. At most RECOMMEND_CONCURRENCY run at once.
